summary: Frontend-only regression + refinamiento validation for Punto Cero One (iteration_8). Verified new Primary Slider (6 handcrafted slides), extended LinkedIn-style widgets (Left+Right), inline widget strips in center feed, /join social-auth placeholder page, legacy routes (/capital, /executive-summary, /investor-pitch-deck, /capital-strategy), header Capital button, and 375px responsive behaviour. All targeted acceptance criteria PASS. No console errors, 0 horizontal overflow at 1440 and 375.
action_items: The social auth buttons in /join are placeholders only (setNotice + timeout). When ready to wire real OAuth (Google/LinkedIn/Facebook/Apple/Microsoft), integrate via Emergent auth playbook (or dedicated OAuth providers) and replace the current notice-only handlers.
Consider giving the Marketplace ComingSoon container an explicit data-testid="widget-marketplace" to make future placeholder assertions cheaper (currently it's identified via 'Próximamente' text).
critical_code_review_comments: PrimarySlides.jsx is ~490 LOC — still fine, but 6 slide bodies could be split into ./slides/*.jsx modules for maintainability.
Widgets.jsx (324 LOC) starts to bundle many unrelated widgets — recommend splitting into subfiles (WeatherWidget.jsx, MarketsWidget.jsx, etc.) once one more widget is added.
InlineWidgetStrip uses hardcoded stats (12/4/27). Fine for MVP but expose as props so the strip can be reused with different data across sections.
SlideCarousel keyboard listener scoping (hovered carousel) prevents cross-carousel arrow-key bleed — good fix.
No data-testid on individual widget containers other than pc-slider-primary + feed-inline-widget-strip; add widget-<name> testids for stable regression coverage.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth flow reached; /join social buttons are placeholders.

(3) Widgets rendering (uppercase titles): CLIMA, MERCADOS, IA DEL DÍA, ENCUESTA, CALENDARIO, PODCAST DESTACADO, APRENDE · CURSOS, PRÓXIMOS LANZAMIENTOS, MARKETPLACE (with 'Próximamente' placeholder), EMPRESA DESTACADA. rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. First rapid-fire probe returned confusing dot-index results due to autoplay+hover timing race; a re-run with fresh clicks and 900ms waits produced clean sequential mapping — indicating the SlideCarousel implementation is correct.
